blindSummary: The clearest law-violence divergence in the country: a trans health-equity statute and refuge/shield protections (top tier of a national risk map), and the second-highest killing rate (11.1 per 100k trans women/yr), including two black trans women shot dead in the state/province's largest city ten weeks apart in 2026. Protective law does not by itself make people safer. Risk sits above the country-wide average, capped by the violence data.
